decisions.reflection: Got more than I asked for.

decisions.title: Start running in the mornings
decisions.notes: I expect to hate this. Trying it for two weeks anyway.
decisions.reflection: The first week was hard, then it felt good.

decisions.title: See the doctor about my knee
decisions.notes: Been putting this off for months. Dreading it.
decisions.reflection: A simple fix. I wish I had gone sooner.

decisions.title: Cut caffeine after noon
decisions.notes: Small experiment for a month.
decisions.reflection: Sleep is about the same.

decisions.title: Tell my sister I cannot host the holidays
decisions.notes: Dreading this conversation. I expect a fight.
decisions.reflection: She understood. We planned it together instead.

decisions.title: Reply to the angry group message right away
decisions.notes: Typed it fast while I was still annoyed.
decisions.reflection: Made it worse. I had to apologize the next day.

decisions.title: Call an old friend I lost touch with
decisions.notes: Feels awkward to reach out after two years.
decisions.reflection: We talked for two hours.

decisions.title: Hire a plumber instead of fixing it myself
decisions.notes: Got two quotes and checked the reviews first.
decisions.reflection: Done in an hour. Worth it.

decisions.notes: Planned it over a weekend and bought sample pots first.
